delete.description: Remove a case from the workspace and cancel active work, retaining local history.

403.description: Only the case owner may delete; valid CSRF is required.

404.description: Case is deleted, missing, or inaccessible.

409.description: Case revision changed; reload before confirming deletion.

put.description: Persist a case-specific exclusion without editing the original search snapshot or corpus.

work_status.title: Work Status
work_status.description: Research progress for the current case revision, not litigation status. Waiting input takes priority over running and queued work; otherwise use the newest task. With no current task, use ready_to_research when active materials exist, or needs_materials.

include_answers.title: Include Answers
include_answers.description: Legacy compatibility field; evidence Word exports contain only materials, suggested evidence and verification questions.

save_to_materials.title: Save To Materials
save_to_materials.description: Save an immutable Word document in materials; false returns a DOCX download without saving.

relevant.title: Relevant
relevant.description: False marks a saved similar case as irrelevant to this case; true removes that exclusion.

version.title: Version
version.description: Current similar-cases version, used to reject conflicting edits.
